how: A general canvas call becomes a request to coordinate a crest and a later request for help finishing its lettering.
Starting is distributed between proposing the crest, selecting its location, and accepting that location by placing colors.
Members debate size, redraw for available space, and compare competing star designs.
Members report initial colors placed and sustained labor getting the emblem up.
Coordinates direct people to the crest without independently announcing completion.
Alerts, returning defenders, and invitations to repair overwrites keep the crest intact through placement ending.
The candidate attribution process explains recognizing friendly helpers, checking placer histories, and discovering that apparent sabotage was an internal design choice.
Members offer repairs for damage and deliberately avoid fighting another neighboring design.
Members negotiate placement, recount contested truces, and dispute which group damaged neighboring art.
Acknowledged damaging overlap and proposed covering are distinguishable from a visitor's unverified accusation of repeated attacks.
Partial loss produces a reported redesign rather than abandonment, without establishing relocation to a different site.
Completion posts, relief, pride, and thanks mark the crest as a group accomplishment.
The defended end state and progress time-lapse preserve what happened to the work.
A member proposes the finished image as a subreddit header, while adoption remains unresolved.
A participant reports using alternate accounts specifically to defend the crest, without establishing scripts or collective control of automation.
A location proposal receives an unqualified assent and report of placed colors, while later explanations receive short thanks.
Neighbors exchange repair offers and promised building help, while members also place spare pixels on other works.
Temporary cooperation is reported as starting a joint flag, while its completion and survival remain unresolved.
A visiting rival's teasing check-in receives an explanation and comparison of contributions.
A request for adjacent space establishes negotiation but does not establish enduring host authority over guest artwork.
A main sticky focuses coordination, while another moderator-marked contribution seeks to keep a neighbor's complaint visible.
Truces and contested encroachment are reported without a coded dispute over who can commit the group.
Annoyance at damaged final pixels does not establish contest over a cleaned copy or an authoritative post-event account.
Reactions to a separate official joke support local April Fools play but do not establish that the canvas proposal or entire room was keyed as a prank.
A builder adapts the crest to available room without judging the project impossible.
The candidate rivalry condition appears in defensive warnings and teasing comparisons while permitting temporary cooperation with the same familiar rivals.
The candidate identity condition explains participants recognizing fellow supporters and describing the work as expressing their shared supporter identity.
An explicit division of work is a local exception to organization without decided arrangements, without testing the across-room prevalence claim.
Rivalry warnings and taunts do not establish a turn using a preexisting tie to name the target of the room's own attack.
The candidate envoy role appears in approaching another room and promising to relay concerns about a joint project's target.
The crest-coordination thread receives an explicit assent and placement report after a member supplies the location.
The proposal itself recruits helpers, so starting and calling overlap rather than forming separate phases.
Upkeep overlaps unresolved design work and completion announcements rather than beginning only after the design is settled.
Border negotiation also occurs during initial construction, so maintenance is not a necessary precursor in this room.
A reported truce does not establish delivered restraint when the same account alleges continuing encroachment and forced redesign.
The participant explicitly connects alternate accounts to defense, but neither numerical insufficiency nor a move to scripts is established.
Members announce and celebrate completion while star revision and defense continue.
Celebration and recording are visible, but the concepts do not establish celebration causing the decision to preserve an image or time-lapse.
The result image receives a proposal to reuse it as the subreddit header, establishing a proposed continuation without adoption.
Constrained space and reported redesign do not establish a lack-of-hands judgment causing relocation.
Coordinates and competing stars do not establish whether a shared template settled the design, including within the unseen chat.
The proposed location receives a bare assent and report of placement without a request in return.
Neighbor help accompanies construction and overlap repair, so an inferred defense-induced shortage cannot explain every exchange.
A placement-and-repair proposal receives a direct reply promising team help with the logo.
A building call and later admitted interference do not establish that the call caused members to attack a rival.
Concern following proposed covering produces a promise to relay objections, without establishing that the destructive action was stopped.
A retrospective report of truces and an accusation of attacks do not establish an attack call causing border negotiation.
Post-event teasing is not linked to a supported attack-call sequence.
Temporary cooperation on a joint flag does not establish a common defensive threat causing the coalition.
The main sticky manages duplicate coordination posts without demonstrating a flood that displaced the host's ordinary activity.
An agreement-to-authority-dispute mechanism cannot be established from contested compliance without a coded challenge to negotiating authority.
An explicit chat-coordination process would explain repeated invitations and concurrent Reddit reporting while preserving uncertainty about unseen decisions.
An explicit explanation process would retain post-event questions and answers that produce informed nonparticipation rather than further recruitment.
Members allocate individual placements between simultaneous builds and defenses, including alternation rather than concentrating on one work.
Repair requires distinguishing friendly redesign from hostile damage because mistaken defense can undo the group's own design.
After the time-lapse, requests for explanation receive mechanics and identity accounts followed by thanks without a commitment to join.
